result.document_summary: A New Jersey Division on Civil Rights brochure summarizing the NJ Law Against Discrimination's housing protections, including the ban on source-of-lawful-income discrimination, and its complaint process.
result.notes: Only the source-of-lawful-income provision falls within the six in-scope categories (screening_restrictions). The rest of the brochure covers general anti-discrimination protections, service animal rules, disability modifications, and complaint procedures, which are out of scope. The brochure (rev. 06.18.15) gives no effective date for the source-of-income protection. The LAD citation to N.J.S.A. 10:5-5mm appears in the document; the general LAD citation N.J.S.A. 10:5-1 et seq. is not stated in the text, so the citation uses the Law Against Discrimination name as given.

rules.title: Source-of-lawful-income discrimination ban (NJ Law Against Discrimination)
rules.requirement: A landlord may not discriminate in housing based on the source of lawful income or the source of lawful rent or mortgage payment, so a lawful Section 8 voucher holder cannot be denied an apartment based solely on that income source.
rules.key_value: No denial based solely on lawful income source (e.g., Section 8 voucher)
rules.citation: New Jersey Law Against Discrimination (N.J.S.A. 10:5-1 et seq.)
rules.quoted_span:
The LAD also prohibits housing discrimination  based
on the source of lawful income or source of lawful rent
or mortgage payment a tenant or purchaser uses.
rules.coverage_text: Applies to the sale or rental of all property in New Jersey, residential or business, except the listed owner-occupancy and religious-organization exceptions.

exemptions.label: Single apartment in a two-family dwelling where the other unit is owner-occupied

all_of.text: The rental of a single apartment or flat in a two-family dwelling
the other occupancy unit of which is occupied by the owner as his/her residence at the time of such rentals

exemptions.label: Room rental in an owner-occupied one-family dwelling

all_of.text: rental of a room or rooms by the owner or occupant of a one-family dwelling occupied by him/her as his/her residence at the time of such rental

rules.exemptions_text: Exempts rental of one apartment in an owner-occupied two-family dwelling and rental of rooms in an owner-occupied one-family dwelling; also religious-organization preference for persons of the same religion (which concerns religion, not income source).
